title: Lookonchain reports Binance hacker moved another 137,602 ETH for laundering
date_note: Xakep.ru says the transfer was on 19 November; crypto.news, published that day, carries Lookonchain's report. Neither page gives an earlier day.
geo_basis: country-level pin; the sources give no headquarters or victim city for Binance, and the pin is placed in the UAE only because other CyberView records on this theft cite the Abu Dhabi court
summary: Blockchain analytics firm Lookonchain reported, as relayed by crypto.news, that the Binance hacker moved another 137,602 ETH ($248.23 million) for laundering on 19 November, in multiple transfers. Elliptic's laundering analysis, updated 26 November, also lists 137,602 ETH moved on 19 November. Neither crypto.news nor Elliptic quotes a Binance statement on this transfer.
plain: Lookonchain, a blockchain analytics firm, says funds from the October Binance theft were moved again on 19 November, a sign they are being laundered. Binance has not been quoted on this transfer.
exec: Lookonchain's report that the stolen funds keep moving shows the October Binance theft is still being laundered.

evidence.quote: The Binance hacker has moved another 137,602 $ETH ($248.23M) for laundering.
19 ноября с кошелька, связанного с октябрьским взломом Binance, перевели 137 602 ETH стоимостью около $248 млн.

validation.note: Two independent publishers state the transfer: crypto.news (relaying Lookonchain) and Elliptic (own analysis). Xakep.ru also reports it. Lookonchain post not read; no Binance statement on this transfer read.

review.note: source attribution: Xakep.ru does not attribute the transfer to Lookonchain; summary and note fixed; UAE pin is assumed, not sourced
